claim_impact: Tier 1 candidate DEEP-DEGRADATION synthetic convergence study; not signed validation; not benchmark agreement. Mesh sweep reports `candidate_observed_unstable` so the trust-score convergence axis falls to the 30/100 raw -> 6/20 weighted floor (linear_static path).

dt_sweep.rationale: Static analysis — no time discretization. Marked stable as a sentinel; convergence_kind=linear_static routes the trust scorer through the mesh-only path (this field is N/A for trust scoring).

mesh_sweep.rationale: Deep-degradation synthetic: refined mesh (2x through-wall, 2x axial) still reports worst σ_t error > 13% vs Lame's analytical. The mesh refinement does not bring the worst per-element error below the 5% engineering tolerance; sweep verdict is `candidate_observed_unstable` for the Phase 13 C regressed-bucket trigger fixture.
